import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv
#check_failure Roth.normOne_nonneg
namespace NormNonnegativeRaw
variable {σ : Type*}
theorem current (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ d ∈ P.support, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
theorem finsuppCurrent (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) :
    0 ≤ P.coeff.sum (fun _ z ↦ |(z : ℝ)|) :=
  Finsupp.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _
theorem supportOnly {ι R S : Type*} [Zero R] [AddCommMonoid S] [Preorder S]
    [IsOrderedAddMonoid S] (f : ι →₀ R) (size : ι → R → S)
    (hsize : ∀ i ∈ f.support, 0 ≤ size i (f i)) : 0 ≤ f.sum size :=
  Finsupp.sum_nonneg hsize
#print axioms current
#print axioms finsuppCurrent
#print axioms supportOnly
end NormNonnegativeRaw
